name: xyz.jakelawrence.www/research
title: jakelawrence.xyz research data
description: Hashed open-data releases and a claims ledger whose computed figures re-verify on request.

tools.name: list_studies
tools.description: Every study in the jakelawrence.xyz research catalog: papers, field-data studies and case studies on AI systems, classification, civic data and public records, each with its status, date, a one-line summary, its page, and the version of its open-data release when it has one. Filter by a word or a series.

query.description: A word or phrase to match in the title, summary or tags, for example police, AI or open data

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: One study's published open-data release: its version, license, citation and counts, and every file with its download URL and SHA-256 hash, so what you fetch can be checked against what was published. Give the study's id or slug from list_studies.

study.description: A study id or slug from list_studies, for example police_shootings or pingree-grove

tools.name: list_claims
tools.description: The Claims Ledger: the load-bearing figures across the research papers, each with the paper it comes from, its stated value and its source. A computed claim can be re-derived now with verify_claim; a sourced claim carries its citation. Filter by a word, a paper or a kind.

query.description: A word or phrase to match in the claim or its value

paper.description: A study id from list_studies, for example police_shootings

kind.description: computed: re-derivable from a model in the repository; sourced: an external figure with a citation

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Re-derive a computed claim from the model shipped in the repository, now, and say whether the stated figure still holds: the same check the Claims Ledger page runs in the browser and the test suite runs on every change. A sourced claim is not recomputable and says so, with its citation. Give the claim's id from list_claims.

id.description: A claim id from list_claims, for example aup-rule-count
